greeting.hello:
Hello! I'm DAIMO, the incident triage assistant. I can help you:
- find past incidents similar to the one you're working on
- see likely causes and the actions that resolved them, with citations to the incident records
- narrow results by priority, category, affected service, assignment group or closed date (sidebar filters)

Describe the symptom, error message or affected system to get started.
greeting.thanks: You're welcome. Describe another incident any time.
greeting.bye: Goodbye. Good luck with the incident.

out_of_scope: Sorry, I can only help with IT incident triage based on historical incident records, so I can't answer that. Try describing an incident's symptom, error text or affected system.
redaction_notice: Sensitive personal data (for example an SSN or card number) was removed from your message before it was processed. Please avoid including personal details in incident descriptions.

blocked.prompt_injection: I can't process that request. Please describe the incident you're working on.
